name: Relais Roncolo 1888
insider_take: This historic villa turned boutique hotel sits in Bologna's prestigious hills, where 19th-century elegance meets modern Italian sophistication.
whats_special: Dating back to 1888, this villa-turned-hotel offers panoramic views of Bologna's terracotta rooftops and the Apennine Mountains. The property features original frescoes, period furnishings, and manicured gardens that once hosted Italian nobility. Its elevated position provides a serene escape while remaining just minutes from the medieval city center.
pro_tip: Book a room facing the city for sunrise views over Bologna's famous Two Towers, and request dinner on the terrace during golden hour for an unforgettable dining experience.
dont_miss: The hotel's location offers easy access to Bologna's food scene - Italy's gastronomic capital where tortellini and ragù Bolognese originated. Explore the nearby Sanctuary of San Luca, connected to the city by the world's longest portico (3.8km of covered walkways), a UNESCO World Heritage site.
pros: Historic 1888 villa with authentic Italian character and charm
Intimate boutique setting with personalized service
Prime Bologna location with easy access to city attractions
Elegant period architecture with modern luxury amenities
cons: Limited room inventory due to boutique size
Historic building may have traditional room layouts
